_about: How usage is attributed to jobs. Telemetry from a job's LaunchAgent carries OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES ai_usage.job=<name>. Logged sessions are matched by their first prompt, then by working folder. The first matching rule wins. {name} in a job takes the regex group of that name, title-cased.
